aim: Find one winning formula, prove it, grow it - then build the next.
written_by: Written on 10 Oct 2026, after Aaron's answers to the four questions about Formula 1 ("fine to go with your suggestions"), from the real broker figures, Trend & Breakout's paper record and the real-price research; the nightly review keeps it up to date.

focus.name: Formula 1
focus.what: LIVE by Aaron's decisions of 9 and 10 Oct. Trend & Breakout's momentum continuation trades on minor currency pairs (EURGBP, AUDJPY and similar) use real money at a flat £13 a trade (0.7% of the balance, never more than £13), with no top-opportunity size until it has 20 live trades. No new entry in the 15 minutes before a high-importance release on either currency of the pair. The daily-loss stop counts real money only; its 3% limit is unchanged. Its other approaches, and the rest of Trend & Breakout, stay on PAPER and still feed the Momentum Runner.
focus.evidence: Its record: 38 real trades over 10 days, 8 days up and 2 down, +£156.31 after £29.89 of commission (+£4.11 a trade). Without its best day it is still +£81 over 25 trades. No other approach on the minor pairs has 20 real trades over 4 days in the conditions it still trades, so the others stay on paper.
focus.caution: Chosen by looking back, so it has to prove itself on new live trades: it is judged after 20 of them, counted from the moment these choices took effect (the live count starts again whenever the set of live trades changes).
focus.source: Trend & Breakout's real trades, 17 Sep - 8 Oct (MetaTrader's figures, after commission); its paper record for 9 Oct

steps.text: Formula 1 live - judge it after 20 live trades, counted from when the 10 Oct choices took effect: keep it and grow it (the top-opportunity size back on) if it is positive after all costs with more days up than down; otherwise back to PAPER and test the next candidate.
Rapid Momentum Rider switched OFF and binned - its own 10-day test on real prices found no edge (1,073 trades, lost 1.33 pips a trade after costs).
Momentum Runner stays LIVE at about £10 a ride, riding Trend & Breakout's index entries from paper.
Financial Ian keeps testing on Binance's public crypto book until it has 30 trades.
Band Breaker and Crowd Fader stay on PAPER, where the next candidate comes from.
